description: No profile requires an engineless control without naming the deployment class expected to satisfy it.
note: This scans every profile, where profiles/unimplementable-controls-stay-optional deliberately names only the three ladder profiles. The two are complements: that one says a LADDER profile requires none of these, this one says any profile that does require one is vertical and says so. Together they close the hole PROF-6a would otherwise open, which is that 'vertical' becomes a label anything can wear to escape PROF-6. The other half of PROF-6a -- whether the named class GENUINELY meets the requirement outside AEGS -- is a judgement no vector can make, and the clause says so rather than pretending otherwise.
